why: The pinned OAI ZMQ radio driver sleeps in zmq_poll for up to 10 ms while a REP reply is owed, which paces the whole lock-step gNB <-> broker <-> nrUE chain to ~0.3x real time (SPARK_MILESTONES.md S9). The OAI gates load this patched module by default; OCUDU_NATIVE_OAI_ZMQ_MODULE=stock opts out.

not_applied.reason: S10: +3% slots/s at 100 MHz unpinned, no gain once the platform CPU split is applied (2,060 vs 2,077 slots/s); kept as a measurement knob only.
